slow_paths.strategy: Separate authorization, zero, insufficient balance, success, failed-recipient and reentrant callback branches.

slow_paths.strategy: Partition branch cases and bounded minted histories, test actual implementation. FUZZ longer action histories.

slow_paths.strategy: Concrete EOA and accepting/rejecting/reentrant receiver fixtures; fixed bytes lengths.

slow_paths.pattern: Nested loops up to 4 lines and 25 characters per line
slow_paths.strategy: Use real renderer plus independently decoded JSON/SVG oracle; explicit 25-character breakpoints and uint256 maximum.

slow_paths.pattern: Assembly and variable-length loops; log10 branch tree
slow_paths.strategy: Fuzz actual renderer with parse/decode oracle. Concrete boundary cases supplement, not universal proof.

slow_paths.pattern: Three arithmetic branches, elapsed*rate symbolic multiplication, time subtraction
slow_paths.strategy: Full bucket, >=one-day and partial refill partitions. State fixtures must be reachable through setLimits and prior use. Add overflow rejection boundary cases.
Test actual setLimits with increasing, decreasing above used amount, and decrease below used amount.

slow_paths.pattern: Symbolic fee multiplication; several revert branches; untrusted external callback
slow_paths.strategy: Separate fee arithmetic, callback outcomes, cap boundaries and nested loans; FUZZ arbitrary callback action sequences.

slow_paths.pattern: Error formatting loops through StringsUpgradeable.toHexString (40/64 hex digits)
slow_paths.strategy: Concrete known role and unauthorized actor fixtures; authorize/deny calls to actual grantRole/revokeRole. Use loop >=64; FUZZ arbitrary role bytes.

slow_paths.pattern: ecrecover cryptographic precompile and multi-branch rejection
slow_paths.strategy: Forge signed-message tests and replay cases. Symbolic simple expiry and high-s rejection paths can avoid ecrecover.

slow_paths.pattern: External dependencies contain adapter loops, mulDiv math, arbitrary adapter calls
slow_paths.strategy: Keep recording-target forwarding tests distinct from real integration. Bounded timelock/adapter removal cases may enumerate list lengths.

trust_assumptions.text: Admin controls operators, generic proxy selectors and arbitrary classifier caps. Operators control strategy routing and approved generic calls. These trusted powers can move protocol funds.
Vault views and adapter IDs are truthful and stable. Adapters list has unique entries and IDs. Morpho owns timelocks and checks actual reported allocation change.
Exact token conservation requires standard ERC20 behavior and WETH 1:1 redemption. Fee-on-transfer, rebasing and malicious balances require separate models.
All authorized accounts can withdraw all custody assets to arbitrary nonzero recipients. Ownership and withdrawal authority are separate maps.
Alchemist can mint/burn and receives a callback on each non-mint ownership update. NFT admin controls metadata and admin transfer. Metadata renderer must not revert for desired IDs.

Proxy initializes atomically. ADMIN_ROLE and whitelisted minters are trusted. No global supply cap exists. Zero bridge maxLimit skips rate enforcement. Upgrade administration is outside this implementation.
Timestamp is monotone and far below uint256 maximum. Generated refill states must correspond to preceding setLimits/mint/burn transitions.
Keccak collision resistance and ECDSA security are assumptions. Signature property tests check integration, not cryptographic security.

limitations: Analysis and planned obligations are not execution results. No property is proven or fuzz-verified yet.
All nine owned sources and inherited financial/control implementations were read. Interfaces and helper code were read for call boundaries. Full external protocols remain separate scope.
Token deployed ABI contains inherited methods despite source-level scope exclusions for lib/. They must not disappear from the report.
No owned source has Math.mulDiv, sqrt or symbolic exponentiation. Allocator uses ordinary checked products. Inherited metadata and external Morpho code add slow paths.
An abstract arithmetic helper alone does not prove the implementation. Any future helper needs implementation equivalence evidence with a stated domain.
Bounded histories and finite list/string lengths are bounded results. One successful symbolic path is not itself proof of vacuity.

Curator removeStrategy executes using stored adapterToMYT, not its myt argument. Fee-vault ownership does not revoke withdrawal authorization. These are observed behaviors requiring explicit specifications, not confirmed vulnerabilities.
Source permits arbitrary classifier percentages and flash-loan cap. Universal liveness/no-overflow cannot be claimed for all admin-selected values.
Generic proxy authorizes selector alone across arbitrary target addresses, arguments and ETH value. Any cap enforcement claim must include configured proxy permissions.
NFT mint uses _mint rather than _safeMint. Receiver acceptance is only required on safe transfers.
Root manages dependency installation and compilation. This task made no repo edits or solver runs.

protocol_types: Vault custody (fee vaults, not ERC4626 share vaults)
Bridge rate limits (no cross-chain message verifier)
